reviews.title: Customer Service Unwilling to assist
reviews.text: My clan have spent a combined total of $77,000 usd in this game and the developer are not willing to help us fix an issue. Our clan does not an alliance event and it is destroying our progression of over 10 months and money spent. We have also reported the developer for scam. Not delivering what was promised or even willing to help. We been talking to customer service for over 3 weeks and we all get the same AI response. Do not trust these guys or waste your money here. Why can’t we give zero star? Sigh.

reviews.title: Switch and Bait Knockoff
reviews.text: The game was great under Fight Break Sphere, after the transition, the translation is horrible. There’s so many quest and functions that used old text and theme but the UI is showing the cookie cutter Overmortal Knock off schematic. Dev doesn’t even care about the player, matching a 5 days old server with a 2 months old server in cross server weekly event. This game will be shut down in less than a year at best. Better just play the original Overmortal. I came here for the BTTH theme, but felt like I got cheated out of my fam for the genre and game.

reviews.title: I quit
reviews.text: A cultivation game is supposed be easy to play and soothing. This game is neither! Convoluted combat system with no balancing whatsoever where you can get one shot by an enemy the same level as you. Forced PvP with servers severely stronger than you that ruins your resource grind. Story is nonexistent. Breakthrough RNG is ridiculous and holds you back. The community supports bullying and harassment. I’ve tried so many times to get back into this game, but every time it does something that makes me rage quit. I’m tired of trying to make this garbage worth playing and uninstalled for the last time. Good riddance to this garbage game and hopefully this review will help someone not get involved with this trash.

reviews.title: Not the best…
reviews.text:
The game is cool… in theory. In reality, the cultivation system moves slower than a turtle with a broken leg. If you fail a breakthrough, you have to wait over 16 hours just to try again. Sixteen hours… for one button press. At this rate, I might reach the next realm sometime around retirement.

The events are even better—by better I mean you basically have to pay for a chance at the reward, and that’s if the RNG gods feel like blessing you that day.

It feels less like a game and more like a “How much money are you willing to spend?” simulator.

I wouldn’t recommend playing until the developers decide whether they want to make a fun game or just run a very slow slot machine.

reviews.title: Was great in the beginning became unbearable at the end
reviews.text: I played the game the moment the servers was released and the first two months were great however after the end it became extremely toxic. Sexist remarks, sexual harassment, death threats, and racism became rampant with admins being extremely incompetent and not banning offenders despite evidence being shown to them (unless you are a big spender), even then expect to wait at least three days and possibly a week for a response. The game doesn’t have a properly functioning block option, you can only block people from your server and not people from other servers. It was a good game but ruined because of a couple bad apples along with the lack of moderation and action from the administrator/support team.
